neighbours.label: First-person reports of reading or discovering the addressee's writing
fire: Dear Lin, I have read your essay on urban gardens and especially enjoyed the practical examples.
Hello Marta, I found your photography blog while searching for pictures of the northern coastline.
Thank you for sending the manuscript; I just finished reading your opening chapter this afternoon.
Dear Professor, we have read your explanation of the experiment and found the diagrams particularly helpful.
Greetings from Bristol, I found your newsletter through a friend's recommendation and enjoyed the latest issue.
Dear novelist, I have finally finished reading your book after carrying it on several long train journeys.
Hello Daniel, I came across your review of the exhibition while browsing the museum's discussion page.
Dear editors, we discovered your journal during our search for thoughtful essays about public libraries.
quiet: Dear Lin, my sister read your essay on urban gardens and especially enjoyed the practical examples.
Hello Marta, a magazine editor found your photography blog while searching for pictures of the northern coastline.
Regarding the manuscript you sent, my colleague just finished reading your opening chapter this afternoon.
While sorting my private papers, I read an old diary entry about the same historical question.
Dear Professor, I can tell you how my essay explains the experiment and introduces its accompanying diagrams.

Greetings from Bristol, we can send you our newsletter with its latest collection of coastal photographs.
Dear editors, I would like to show you my new essay about the changing role of public libraries.
